findings.description: The docstring says the section is shown if at least one argument is documented, but the condition uses all(...) instead of any(...). The section is therefore only shown when every argument has help, and the same check is true for an empty list.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command with two arguments where only one has help. all() returns False, so the whole section is omitted, which is a regression from the old behavior of listing the documented argument. Trigger 2: a command with no arguments. all([]) is True, so an empty 'Positional arguments' section header is printed with no entries. Fix: use any().
